description: The file 'irq.c' contains implementation code for interrupt handling, initialization, priority setting, and related functions for a PowerPC MPC55xx architecture within an AUTOSAR platform. It includes setup of interrupt vector tables, enabling/disabling interrupts, and managing interrupt priorities.

methods.name: void Irq_Init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt controller, sets up the exception vector table and configures interrupt handling modes.

methods.name: void Irq_EOI(void)
methods.description: Ends the interrupt request by writing to the End Of Interrupt register.

methods.name: void Irq_SetPriority(Cpu_t cpu,IrqType vector,uint8_t prio)
methods.description: Sets the priority of a given interrupt vector for a specific CPU core.

methods.name: void Irq_EnableVector(int16_t vector,int priority,int core)
methods.description: Enables a specific interrupt vector with a given priority on a designated core.

methods.name: void Irq_GenerateSoftInt(IrqType vector)
methods.description: Generates a software interrupt for a specified vector.

methods.name: uint8_t Irq_GetCurrentPriority(Cpu_t cpu)
methods.description: Returns the current priority level of the specified CPU core.

ctags.name: Irq_EnableVector
ctags.pattern: /^void Irq_EnableVector( int16_t vector, int priority, int core ) {$/

ctags.name: Irq_SetPriority
ctags.pattern: /^void Irq_SetPriority( Cpu_t cpu,  IrqType vector, uint8_t prio ) {$/
